units.source_text: 过了正月初一之后，匂亲王从六条院来到二条院。

en.t: After New Year's Day had passed, Prince Niou came from Rokujo-in to Nijo-in.

units.source_text: 小公子开年又长大了一岁。

en.t: With the new year, the young lord had grown another year older.

units.source_text: 有一天昼间，匂亲王正在和小公子玩耍，看见一个幼年女童姗姗地走来，

en.t: One day at noon, while Prince Niou was playing with the young lord, he saw a little girl walking slowly toward them,

units.source_text: 手中拿着一个用绿色晕渲的纸包好的大信封、一根附有小须笼的小松枝，此外还有一封不加装饰的普通立文式的信。

en.t: holding a large envelope wrapped in paper shaded with green, a little pine branch with a small decorative basket attached, and also a plain, undecorated folded letter.

units.source_text: 她正要把这些东西送与二女公子。

en.t: She was about to deliver these things to the Second Princess.

units.source_text: 匂亲王问道：“这是哪里送来的？”

en.t: Prince Niou asked, "Where have these come from?"

units.source_text: 女童答道：“是宇治送来给大辅君的。

en.t: The girl answered, "They were sent from Uji for Lady Taifu.

units.source_text: 那使者找不到大辅君，交不出去。

en.t: The messenger could not find Lady Taifu and was unable to hand them over.

units.source_text: 我想宇治来的东西向来是送交夫人看的，所以接受了。”

en.t: I thought things from Uji were always shown to the lady of the house, so I accepted them."

units.source_text: 她说时上气不接下气。

en.t: As she spoke, she was out of breath.

units.source_text: 继而又笑着说道：“这须笼是用金属做的，上面涂着彩色。

en.t: Then she laughed and added, "This little basket is made of metal and painted in colors.

units.source_text: 这松枝也做得很巧妙，同真的一样。”

en.t: This pine branch is very cleverly made too, just like a real one."

units.source_text: 匂亲王也笑了，说道：“拿过来，让我也来玩赏一下。”

en.t: Prince Niou laughed as well and said, "Bring it here. Let me enjoy looking at it too."

units.source_text: 二女公子心中着急，说道：“这封信交给大辅君去吧。”

en.t: The Second Princess grew anxious and said, "Please give that letter to Lady Taifu."

units.source_text: 说时脸上泛红。

en.t: As she said this, her face flushed.

units.source_text: 匂亲王想道：“大概是薰大将给她的信，故意说是给大辅的。

en.t: Prince Niou thought, "It is probably a letter from General Kaoru to her, and she is deliberately saying it is for Taifu.

units.source_text: 用宇治的名义，定然是他的了。”

en.t: Since it uses the name of Uji, it must certainly be his."

units.source_text: 就把信取了过来。

en.t: So he took the letter over to himself.

units.source_text: 但他到底有些顾虑：如果真是薰大将给她的，岂不使她难堪。

en.t: Still, he had some misgivings: if it really was from General Kaoru to her, would that not embarrass her?

units.source_text: 便说道：“我拆开来了。

en.t: So he said, "I am going to open it.

units.source_text: 你不会怨我么？”

en.t: You will not resent me for it, will you?"

units.source_text: 二女公子说：“太不成样子了！

en.t: The Second Princess said, "That would be terribly improper!

units.source_text: 侍女们私人间的通信，你怎么可以拆看呢？”

en.t: How can you open and read private letters between ladies-in-waiting?"

units.source_text: 说时并无狼狈之色。

en.t: As she said this, she showed no sign of confusion.

units.source_text: 匂亲王说：“原来如此，那么我就拆看了。

en.t: Prince Niou said, "I see. In that case, I will open it and look.

units.source_text: 女人之间写的信是什么样儿的？”

en.t: What are letters written between women like?"

units.source_text: 他把那封信拆开一看，但见笔迹非常稚嫩，信中写道：“阔别多时，不觉岁历云暮。

en.t: He opened the letter and saw that the handwriting was very immature; it said, "After so long apart, the year has somehow drawn to its close.

units.source_text: 山中荒居岑寂，峰顶云封雾锁，不知何处是京华也。”

en.t: In this lonely, rough dwelling in the mountains, with the peaks sealed in clouds and mist, I no longer know where the capital lies."

units.source_text: 信纸一端又附记曰：“此粗陋之物，奉赠小公子哂纳。”

en.t: At one edge of the letter there was also a note: "Please accept this humble little thing as a gift for the young lord."

units.source_text: 此信写得并不特别漂亮，但看不出是谁的手笔。

en.t: The letter was not written in any especially beautiful hand, but he could not tell whose handwriting it was.

units.source_text: 匂亲王心中疑怪，便把那封立文式的信也拆开来看，果然也是女子的笔迹。

en.t: Prince Niou grew suspicious and opened the folded letter as well; sure enough, it too was in a woman's hand.

units.source_text: 信中写道：“岁历更新，尊府想必平安无事，贵体亦必康泰纳福。

en.t: The letter said, "Now that the year has turned, your household must surely be at peace, and you yourself must be in good health and blessed with fortune.

units.source_text: 此间环境美好，照顾周到，然而终不适于小姐居住。

en.t: The surroundings here are pleasant and the care is attentive, but in the end it is not a suitable place for the young lady to live.

units.source_text: 我等亦常奉劝：与其在此沉思闷坐，不如常往尊处奉访，以慰岑寂之心。

en.t: We often advise her that instead of sitting here sunk in gloomy thoughts, she should visit you often and ease her lonely heart.

units.source_text: 但小姐鉴于上次所遭可耻可怕之事，已怀戒心，不敢前来，言之不胜愁叹。

en.t: But because of the shameful and frightening thing that happened last time, the young lady has become wary and does not dare to come, which grieves us more than words can say.

units.source_text: 卯槌一柄，乃小姐奉赠小公子者，请于亲王不在家时代为奉呈。”

en.t: This hare mallet is a gift from the young lady to the young lord; please present it on her behalf when the prince is away from home."

units.source_text: 此外又不顾新年忌讳，写着许多悲伤愁叹的话。

en.t: Besides this, heedless of New Year's taboos, the letter contained many sorrowful and lamenting words.

units.source_text: 匂亲王觉得此信乖异，反复察看，不胜讶怪，便问二女公子：“你告诉我吧，这是谁写来的信？”

en.t: Prince Niou found the letter strange, read it over and over, and, unable to contain his astonishment, asked the Second Princess, "Tell me, who wrote this letter?"

units.source_text: 二女公子答道：“这是从前宇治山庄中一个侍女的女儿，听说最近不知为了何事，借住在那边。”

en.t: The Second Princess answered, "It is from the daughter of a lady-in-waiting who used to be at the Uji villa. I heard that lately, for some reason, she has been staying there."

units.source_text: 匂亲王觉得这不是普通侍女的女儿所写的信。

en.t: Prince Niou felt that this was not a letter written by the daughter of an ordinary lady-in-waiting.

units.source_text: 看到信中“上次所遭可耻可怕之事”一语，恍悟这便是以前邂逅的那个女子。

en.t: When he saw the phrase "the shameful and frightening thing that happened last time," he suddenly realized that this was the woman he had once encountered.

units.source_text: 他看看那卯槌，觉得非常精致，显然是寂寞无聊的人所做的。

en.t: He looked at the hare mallet and found it extremely delicate, clearly the work of someone lonely and weary of idleness.

units.source_text: 形成桠杈的小松枝上，插着一只人造的山橘，附有诗云：

en.t: On the forked little pine branch, an artificial mountain orange had been inserted, and a poem was attached:
